The plate is about 26 cm across, and the food covers roughly 10 x 8 cm. The pieces are roasted cubes of about 1.5-2 cm. They look mostly like sweet potato (orange), with a few paler cubes that could be regular potato, plus a few dark pieces that could be mushroom or charred edges.

I count about 30 cubes at roughly 4-5 g each, which comes to about 120-130 g. The pile is only one layer deep in most places, so I'll go slightly lower, near 110 g.

I split the portion into about 85 g roasted sweet potato at 120 kcal/100 g, 15 g roasted potato at 130 kcal/100 g, and 10 g dark pieces at 100 kcal/100 g. There is only a slight sheen on the cubes, so I'm not adding oil as a separate item.
